challenge.method: I read the exact guide opening and versioned release changes against the ISO language identity. I looked for an edition designation in the cited comparison and challenged the inference that the parent’s Part 1 locator establishes SQLite conformance to that edition. https://www.iso.org/standard/76583.html
challenge.results: Both SQLite sources concern SQLite’s SQL surface. The guide attributes omissions and additions relative to standard SQL in general and names no ISO edition in that comparison. The release identifies 3.46.0 without making a conformance claim. The parent locator identifies the catalog’s SQL language.

limitations: The missing edition designation finding applies to the cited characterization and release evidence.
The relation is a catalog classification. SQL conformance, certification, portability and unsupported releases are outside the claim.
